units: <cite ref="Berakhot 33b:19">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה ידע … לרַצּוּיֵי למריה</he> how well that scholar knows how to appease his Master! <cite ref="Yoma 7a:8">Yoma 7ᵃ</cite> <he>למה לי לרצויי</he> what need would there be for the atoning power of the priest’s plate?; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 100b">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 31:1">Yalk. Gen. 31</cite>, v. infra.
Erub. 100ᵇ דמַרְצְיָא אַרְצוּיֵי קמיה (Ms. M. דמרצי רַצּוּיֵי, read: דמְרַצְּיָא, Pa.) she makes herself pleasant (attractive) to him; Yalk. Gen. 31 דמְרַצְּיָיא רַצּוּיֵיה she tries to please him.
<cite ref="Chagigah 14b">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>דא׳ זאַרְצוּ קמיה וכ׳</he> he mentions only such a one as discoursed (on theosophy), and before whom others discoursed.
<cite ref="Chagigah 14b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>דא׳ מיהא קמיה מאן דא׳</he> he at least discoursed before one who again discoursed before others.
<cite ref="Taanit 23b:9">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>אפשר דמִירְצֵי הקב״ה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>דמִתְרְצֵי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) peradventure the Lord will be appeased and send rain.
